title: Networking
description: Can read Ethernet/IP/TCP/UDP/DNS/TLS on the wire, write sockets, and choose which layer to trust when a capture and an application log disagree.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can capture a packet, label MAC, IP, port and hostname on it, and compute a subnet from a written prefix — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can annotate a capture that includes DNS and a default-gateway hop, write a socket client that handles disconnect, and choose TCP versus UDP for a stated payload with a one-sentence reason.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently identify handshake and sequence/ack behavior in a capture, implement a socket server that survives a peer reset, and distinguish TLS encryption, authentication and certificates on that path.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a failure where DNS, routing or TLS alone would mislead, cite the capture fields that prove it, and produce a note another on-call can follow without opening application source.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's capture or socket code, name a field they mislabeled (MAC as IP, or TLS as encryption-only), and teach when to trust a packet dump over an application log on an unfamiliar host.
